AC2.evidence: middleware/auth.ts no longer uses (prisma as any)[model]. Replaced with findResourceCreator() — a type-safe switch over known models (role, goal, signedDocument, document) using each model's specific Prisma delegate with correct field selection.

decisions: Used 'as unknown as PrismaType' pattern (not direct 'as PrismaType') because test mocks provide partial objects missing required fields — direct 'as Session' would fail TS compile

Used switch-based typed dispatch (not generic Record<string,any> map) for middleware/auth.ts because different models have different ownership fields (creatorId vs createdBy) and Prisma delegates have incompatible select types
Added 'import type' for Prisma types to ensure they're erased at runtime — avoids vitest module resolution failures since @prisma/client may not be fully built in CI/dev environments
uncertainties: findResourceCreator only handles 4 models (role, goal, signedDocument, document) — these are the only models with creatorId/createdBy in the current schema. If new ownership-tracked models are added, the switch must be extended.
constraintsDiscovered: Original (prisma as any)[model] would silently accept any model name at runtime — the typed switch will return undefined (→ 404) for unknown models, which is safer
Prisma types have all non-nullable fields as required — partial mock objects cannot use direct 'as Type' assertion, requiring 'as unknown as Type' bridge
